title: docs(pm-dispatch): a decision analysis recommends exactly one option
body:
Fixes #24444

Clause-②: no

## What

Two lines of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md`, nothing else (1 file, +2 / −2):

- **line 9** (the director's pre-batch increment): 「推荐/回退/口径」 → 「推荐/口径」, the card's wording verbatim.
- **line 26** (the recommendation item of the card-face template): 「推荐 + 回退 + 置信缺口:荐一项、给回退项、明说看不见什么;⛔ 不沿用他席推荐。」 → 「推荐 + 置信缺口:只荐一,余各一句不取理由;盲区明说,⛔ 不因此另荐;⛔ 不沿用他席推荐。」

The four facets, the 自检 line and the 裁后执行 paragraph are untouched; `SKILL.md` is untouched.

## Why

The maintainer, 2026-10-19: 「你的决裁总是有一个回退合理吗？是完全不同的开发方向。最终结论应该只有一个吧？是 skills 的问题吗」, then 「同意」 on the card's change. Ruling of record: director ledger comment `6259199455` (on #12708).

## Route A: compressed in place, line count unchanged

The card's line-26 text measures 150 bytes; the ratchet's `MAX_LINE_BYTES` is 120 (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`), and the file sits at 50 lines against its 50-line ceiling (headroom 0). So the ruled wording cannot land verbatim on one line. Route A (compress the wording, keep every clause, add no line) loses no clause, so route B (fold the verbatim text into two lines and raise the ceiling 50 → 51 under the ruling) was not taken and the `CEILINGS` row is unchanged.

Clause survival, ruled text → landed fragment:

| Ruled clause (card text) | Landed fragment | Change |
|---|---|---|
| item name 推荐 + 置信缺口 | 推荐 + 置信缺口 | verbatim |
| ① 只荐一项 | 只荐一 | measure word 项 dropped |
| ② 其余选项各一句不取理由 | 余各一句不取理由 | 其余选项 → 余 (the remaining options, set against 一) |
| ③ 看不见什么明说 | 盲区明说 | 看不见什么 → 盲区 (blind spots) |
| ④ ⛔ 不因此给第二推荐 | ⛔ 不因此另荐 | 给第二推荐 → 另荐 (recommend another); 因此 and ⛔ kept |
| ⑤ ⛔ 不沿用他席推荐 | ⛔ 不沿用他席推荐 | verbatim, byte-identical to the old line's tail |

Nothing is added: no new clause, no new term, each clause keeps its own separator and its own ⛔. A shared-⛔ variant that kept 只荐一项 whole (`…盲区明说,⛔ 不因此另荐,不沿用他席推荐。`, 119 B) was weighed and refused, because it lets 因此 read across clause ⑤.

## Line budget

| | before | after | ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| file lines | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| line 9 bytes | 119 | 112 | 120 |
| line 26 bytes | 110 | 120 | 120 |

Control: with the card's verbatim text placed at line 26, the gate's own `scanLineLengths` reports `[{"line":26,"bytes":150}]`; on the landed tree it reports `[]`.

## Premise checks on `origin/main` `f4755a68a`

- The card's line numbers 13 and 30 are off: the two strings sit at lines 9 and 26.
- `git grep -n "回退" f4755a68a -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/ .claude/agents/` gives 15 hits. Only these two are decision-analysis uses; the rest (os-dev wording ×4, `SKILL.md` line 249's `??` fallback, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `execution-duties.md`, `lanes/triage.md`, `platform-readings.md` ×3, `reading-discipline.md`) are untouched.
- No script, test or doc pins the old wording: `git grep` for 回退/口径, 给回退项 and 推荐 + 回退 finds only the two lines themselves.

Also run: `pnpm check:pm-settings-deny-roster` exit 0 (its roster lives under `.claude`). `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch` answers GOVERNED, Tier S (exit 3, the governed code). Text-only change: no tests, no ablation. The type-check lanes, `test:repo` and `pnpm lint` belong to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Tier S (`.claude/**` only). This PR stays a draft; ready and queue belong to the owning seat after an isolated contract-tier review.
- No changeset: `.claude/**` publishes nothing; `skip-changeset` is declared with this PR's creation.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 决策分析写法删掉「回退项」。总监批前增量从「推荐/回退/口径」改为「推荐/口径」;卡面推荐条改为「推荐 + 置信缺口」:只荐一个方案,其余方案各用一句话说明为何不取,看不见的地方明说,但不因此再给第二个推荐。只动这两行,文件仍是 50 行。
- **为什么改:** 您指出「最终结论应该只有一个」。旧模板要求每次附一个回退项,实际常是另一条完全不同的开发方向,等于把决定又推回给您。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯文本,不发布,不影响产品运行。第 26 行为了压进每行 120 字节的上限做了措辞压缩(「其余选项」→「余」、「看不见什么」→「盲区」、「给第二推荐」→「另荐」、「只荐一项」→「只荐一」),五个分句全部保留,但不是卡上原文逐字。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个提交。
- **席位意见:**
